introHtml: Faux leather badge ID holders offer a professional, eco-friendly alternative to standard plastic or vinyl options. The soft, textured material resists cracking and peeling, making it ideal for daily use by employees in corporate offices, healthcare facilities, or trade shows. Choose from vertical or horizontal orientations, and add your logo with debossing, foil stamping, or screen printing for a refined look that stands out from typical badge holders.
